description:
Meet the all-new 2025 EVRYjourney Recumbent Electric Rickshaw – a revolutionary update to our best-selling electric rickshaw, designed for unmatched comfort, stability, and versatility. Featuring our patent pending hitch system and an all-new recumbent driver’s seat, this model takes your riding experience to a whole new level.

The recumbent design provides a low, relaxed seating position with back support and armrests, making it easier to mount, dismount, and ride for extended periods. Whether you’re cruising with family, giving passengers a scenic tour, or running errands around town, you’ll enjoy a ride that’s as easy on your body as it is fun to drive.

Recumbent Driver’s Position: Enjoy maximum comfort with a supportive seat, armrests, and an ergonomic riding posture that reduces strain on your back, hips, and knees.

Comfort Handlebars: The comfort bars make it easy to steer and comfortable for riders arms. Easily adjust the angle and length of stem to find the perfect handlebar position for your body.

Patent Pending Rear Hitch: Attach an extra row of seats or a cargo trailer basket in seconds – perfect for family rides, beach trips, or hauling gear. (Accessories sold separately.)

Hydraulic Disc Brakes (Front & Rear): Three powerful hydraulic disc brakes provide superior stopping power and automatically adjust as pads wear for consistent, safe braking.

Heavy-Duty Passenger Support: Reinforced under-seat supports handle up to 300 lbs on the passenger bench, so you can bring friends, family, or supplies without worry.

Fat Tire Stability: 20" rear wheels and a 16" front wheel with 4-inch-wide fat tires deliver a smooth, cushioned ride over pavement, gravel, grass, and boardwalks.

Powerful 750W Motor: Ride in pedal assist or full-electric throttle mode with plenty of torque for hills, cargo, and multiple passengers.

Extras: Rear-view mirrors for enhanced visibility, integrated hitch system, stable low-center-of-gravity design

Whether you’re touring the neighborhood, heading to the park, or shuttling loved ones along the coast, the EVRYjourney Recumbent Electric Rickshaw blends power, comfort, and cargo capacity into one unforgettable ride.
